prospective_amendment.unchanged: exactly one accepted credited hour per arm; pinned learner triple 4:1:1 schedule; shared adapter; corrected assets; modular German TTS; point estimates only; no grammar aggregate equivalence inference or evaluation-driven generator tuning

post_gate_descriptive_extension.question: does this particular one-accepted-hour locally governed LTX corpus produce a directionally similar training effect under the identical learner procedure
post_gate_descriptive_extension.permitted_interpretation: a positive synthetic training effect resembling the observed real effect may be described only as encouraging descriptive evidence
post_gate_descriptive_extension.inconclusive_rule: if both matched arms are flat or decline the comparison is inconclusive
post_gate_descriptive_extension.outcome_independence: the extension generator corpus cap learner seeds steps checkpoints evaluation assets calibration axes and resource-gate order are frozen before any synthetic learner outcome

learner.objective_step_basis: ceil((5 passes * 622 contrastive batches per pass) / 4 contrastive updates per complete cycle) = 778 complete cycles; 778 * 6 = 4668 scheduler steps
learner.data_contract: each accepted-hour learner manifest contains exactly 1244 records; contrastive and DINO iterators are independent deterministic streams so non-contrastive scheduler steps do not discard contrastive coverage

calibration_C.episode_plan_contract: freeze a public nonrestricted episode-plan distribution matched axis-by-axis to approved targets using only public lexical resources and no sealed evaluation concepts or outcomes

calibration_C.attempt_accounting: measure every generated attempt and the accepted corpus separately
calibration_C.scale_up_evidence: real arm learns; synthetic improves over initialization; synthetic-real realistic macro gap at most 0.05; held-out-real temporal safeguard non-catastrophic; no critical calibration-axis failure; most axes within frozen tolerances; no severe preregistered joint-distribution miss; acceptable unique-hour yield and cost

acquisition: reuse the sealed exact Real-1h manifest; no additional real acquisition; synthetic may exceed one raw generated hour only within the frozen production ceilings to yield exactly one accepted credited hour

synthetic_arm: NOT_RUN; both earlier calibration no-gos are preserved and the user-authorized domain-appropriate extractor redesign must pass pre-model feasibility public egocentric qualification and the unchanged governed C gate before LTX work
positive_learning_signal: per arm the mean seed-matched realistic macro gain is at least 0.02 and at least two of three seed gains are positive; all temporal safeguards satisfy the frozen non-catastrophic rule
former_directionally_competitive_rule_no: both arms meet the positive learning signal and the absolute difference between their mean realistic lexical macros is at most 0.05
null_interpretation: a similar null or decline is inconclusive about corpus data quality and cannot be called directional comparability
